CommunityApplications.Profile:
Dockkeep runs scheduled [Restic](https://restic.net/) backups and [Rclone](https://rclone.org/) syncs in one container, with a web UI.
You describe *what* to back up, *where to*, and *when* in the UI; Dockkeep stores that as one plain TOML file and takes care of running the jobs, pruning snapshots, mirroring repositories off-site, logging, notifying you when something breaks, and restoring files when you need them.
Repositories stay ordinary Restic repositories that any `restic` binary can read, with or without Dockkeep.
**The web UI has no built-in authentication.** It is an administrative interface with full access to your configuration and secrets. Keep it on a trusted network, or put it behind a VPN or an authenticating reverse proxy.
Support: https://forums.unraid.net/topic/200129-support-d4v3-dockkeep/ · Bug reports: https://github.com/DavidKrGH/Dockkeep/issues
